themes.title: The land and who lived there
themes.intro: Lines about whether Palestine was a real, populated place before 1948, and whose history it holds.

claims.claim: Palestine never existed. There was never a country called Palestine.
The Palestinian people were invented in the 1960s.
It was a land without a people for a people without a land.
Jews are the indigenous people of the land, and Arabs are the colonizers.
Jordan is already the Palestinian state.
Jews and Muslims have been fighting over that land for thousands of years.

themes.title: 1948 and the refugees
themes.intro: Lines about how Israel was founded, how the war went, and why some 700,000 Palestinians became refugees.

claims.claim: Israel was created because of the Holocaust.
Israel accepted the UN partition plan; the Arabs rejected it and started the war.
Palestinians left in 1948 because Arab leaders told them to.
The Nakba is exaggerated; there were no massacres in 1948.
Tiny Israel won the 1948 war against impossible odds.
Why don't Arab countries just take the Palestinian refugees?

themes.title: October 7 and the Gaza war
themes.intro: Lines about the attack itself, Israel's response, and how the dead and the hungry are counted.

claims.claim: October 7 came out of nowhere; there was no context at all.
Hamas beheaded 40 babies on October 7.
Hamas are terrorists and Israel has the right to defend itself.
The IDF is the most moral army in the world.
Hamas uses human shields, so the civilian deaths in Gaza are on Hamas.
Gaza's death toll is made up by Hamas.
There is no famine in Gaza; the starvation stories are propaganda.
The world court has already ruled that Israel committed genocide.

themes.title: Wars, occupation and peace
themes.intro: Lines about who starts the wars, what the occupation is in law, and who walked away from peace.

claims.claim: Israel never starts wars; it only responds.
Israel gave Gaza back in 2005 and got rockets in return.
There is no occupation; the West Bank is disputed territory.
The Palestinians rejected every peace offer they were given.
Israel wants coexistence; peace is up to the Palestinians.
Israel's real plan is a Greater Israel from the Nile to the Euphrates.

themes.title: Democracy, rights and Palestinian politics
themes.intro: Lines about Israel's democracy, the rights of the people it governs, and the record of Palestinian leaderships.

claims.claim: Israel is the only democracy in the Middle East.
Arab citizens of Israel have exactly the same rights as Jewish citizens.
Israel is an apartheid state.
Palestinian schoolbooks teach children to hate Jews.
Israel created Hamas.
Netanyahu kept Hamas afloat with Qatari money to block a Palestinian state.

themes.title: Iran and the neighbors
themes.intro: Lines about Iran, the armed groups it backs, and Israel's ties with Arab states.

claims.claim: Israel isn't the enemy of the Arab countries; Iran is.
Iran has always been a hostile theocracy.
Israel and Iran have always been enemies.
Hamas, Hezbollah and the Houthis are just Iranian proxies with no causes of their own.
The Abraham Accords brought peace to the Middle East.

themes.title: America: money, aid and the message
themes.intro: Lines about US aid, the pro-Israel lobby, and where the talking points themselves come from.

claims.claim: AIPAC is just an ordinary lobby like any other.
AIPAC money buys Congress.
Without US aid, Israel couldn't defend itself.
Aid to Israel all gets spent in America anyway.
Pro-Israel posts online are just ordinary people; nobody is paid.
The UN is biased against Israel.

themes.title: Antisemitism and criticism of Israel
themes.intro: Lines about where criticism of a state ends and hatred of Jews begins.

claims.claim: Anti-Zionism is antisemitism.
Any criticism of Israel is antisemitic.
Zionism is Judaism, so opposing Zionism means opposing Jews.
Free Palestine is just code for antisemitism.
BDS is an antisemitic movement.

themes.title: Lines aimed the other way
themes.intro: Lines that target Jews or lean on old antisemitic tropes, held to the same standard as every other line here.

claims.claim: Ashkenazi Jews are really Khazars with no tie to the land.
Jews were gone from the land for 2,000 years until Zionism.
The Rothschilds paid for Zionism; Herzl's movement was their project.
Six million is a made-up round number nobody can verify.
The Zionists collaborated with the Nazis.
One secret Israel lobby controls the governments of every Western country.
Epstein was obviously running a Mossad operation.

uncovered.claim: Jews control the media, Hollywood and the banks.
uncovered.why_it_matters: One of the most repeated antisemitic tropes online; no scene checks it directly. The nearest scenes cover named media owners (Maxwell, Axel Springer, Fox) and the Federal Reserve myth, not the generalized claim.
The deicide charge is the oldest root of Christian antisemitism and resurfaces in Gaza-war comment sections; no scene addresses it.
Widely shared conspiracy; fis_s10b covers the pre-9/11 art-student affair but does not check the 9/11 foreknowledge or dancing-Israelis claims themselves.

uncovered.claim: The Protocols of the Elders of Zion show the Jewish plan for world control.
uncovered.why_it_matters: A documented forgery that still circulates; the book has no scene on its origin or exposure.
A recurring blood-libel-style claim with a specific documented history (the 2009 Aftonbladet story, the Abu Kabir institute admissions) that needs careful separating; not covered.

uncovered.claim: American Jews have dual loyalty to Israel.
uncovered.why_it_matters: A classic trope often blended with legitimate lobbying questions; cm_s07 covers the Omar controversy but not the trope itself as a claim about a people.

uncovered.claim: The Holocaust didn't happen, or the gas chambers are a myth.
uncovered.why_it_matters: hol_s05 checks the six million figure, but outright denial of the camps and gas chambers has no dedicated scene.
Holocaust inversion is a widely repeated line on the other side; az_s01 mentions the IHRA example but no scene checks the comparison itself.

uncovered.claim: Hamas committed mass rape on October 7, or the rape reports were invented.
uncovered.why_it_matters: Both versions are heavily repeated; no scene covers the UN (Patten) report, the Israeli and media investigations, or the disputes over specific accounts.

uncovered.claim: UNRWA is Hamas, and its staff took part in October 7.
uncovered.why_it_matters: Drove funding cuts by the US and others; UNRWA appears in scenes but the staff-participation allegations and the Colonna review are not checked.

uncovered.claim: From the river to the sea is a call for genocide.
uncovered.why_it_matters: One of the most argued-over slogans online, used both as a rallying cry and as evidence of intent; no scene traces its history or competing uses (including Likud's 1977 platform).
A central Israeli government message after October 7; no scene compares the two organizations' ideology, aims, and documented rivalry.

uncovered.claim: Israel is the only progressive state in the region; look at gay rights in Tel Aviv.
uncovered.why_it_matters: The progressive half of a framing-study message, and the pinkwashing counter-argument, are both uncovered; sk_s02 handles only the democracy half.

uncovered.claim: Israel started the 1956 Suez war together with Britain and France.
uncovered.why_it_matters: Audit item #22 and a Myths and Facts chapter; Suez appears only in passing (egi_src_s02, me_s08), with no scene on the Sèvres protocol and who struck first.

uncovered.claim: Smotrich showed a Greater Israel map that includes Jordan, Lebanon and Syria.
uncovered.why_it_matters: Audit item #35, researched but not built; it must be kept distinct from Netanyahu's 2023 UN map (gia_s01), which the book does cover.

uncovered.claim: Never Again applies only to Jews.
uncovered.why_it_matters: Audit item #61, a live 2026 argument over the phrase's universal or particular meaning; not covered.

uncovered.claim: Gaza's civilians are fair targets because they elected Hamas.
uncovered.why_it_matters: A common justification line; hma_src_s04 covers the 2006 election and hma_src_s15 the proportionality rule, but no scene checks the claim's demographic premise (no vote since 2006, about half of Gaza under 18) together with the law.
